notes.subject: בלי פחד
notes.rationale: 'Without fear' — does it describe the ostrich (she fears no one, so her labor is carelessly wasted, KJV/JPS) or that her toil meets no alarm (ASV)? Rendered as the ostrich having no fear.

notes.subject: kaltek
notes.rationale: הקשיח is literally 'make hard/unfeeling' — rendered with the Tok Pisin idiom 'mekim bel kaltek' (make the belly neglect) to keep the picture of hardness of feeling.

translation: Em i mekim bel bilong em kaltek long ol pikinini bilong em, olsem ol i no bilong ⟨em⟩; wok bilong em i wok nating, em i no gat wanpela pret.

tokens.gloss: Em i mekim bel bilong em kaltek
